# Moeez Ahmad Khan

> AI/ML engineer in Lahore, working remotely. Edge computer vision, clinical LLM
> systems, research agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest.
> Available for remote work; replies within one working day.

Every figure on the site is marked measured or not measured. Unmeasured claims
are drawn as hollow outlines rather than dropped, and the open defects of each
system are published alongside its results.

## The work

- [Vanguard — edge face recognition](https://moeezahmadkhan.com/#vanguard): Four networks on a Sophon BM1688 TPU, fully offline. 2,676 of 10,291 faces cleared the quality gate; every rejection shows the reading that killed it. Solo build, 186 commits.
- [Sumero Health — clinical LLM](https://moeezahmadkhan.com/#sumero): Triage router at 93.0% over 187 prompts, a 214-prompt graded set, and a 179-case regression suite with 22 criticals still open. Owns the AI service and the whole evaluation harness.
- [Pawlyse — research agent](https://moeezahmadkhan.com/#pawlyse): A two-round retrieval loop bounded by a 140-second wall clock, at most six citations, nothing logged. Sole author of the ML service.
- [Nexis — LLM deal scoring](https://moeezahmadkhan.com/#nexis): Eleven weighted dimensions combined in code rather than by the model. Built with one other engineer who owned the rubrics; never reached production.
